units.source_text: 岛村明白，自己从一开头就是想找这个女子，可自己偏偏和平常一样拐弯抹角，不免讨厌起自己来。

en.t: Shimamura understood that from the very beginning he had wanted to find this woman, yet he had gone on beating around the bush as usual, and he could not help feeling disgusted with himself.

units.source_text: 与此同时，越发觉得这个女子格外的美了。

en.t: At the same time, she seemed to him all the more extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 从刚才她站在杉树背后喊他之后，他感到这个女子的倩影是多么袅娜多姿啊。

en.t: Ever since she had stood behind the cedar trees and called to him, he felt how graceful and slender her figure was.
